summary: Fetches and eval()s unpinned remote script from unpkg at load time
details: src/hive.mjs re-exports from hive.config.lib.mjs, which transitively reaches config.lib.mjs. config.lib.mjs runs `await ensureUseM()` at top level. That helper (use-m-bootstrap.lib.mjs) performs an HTTP fetch of https://unpkg.com/use-m/use.js — an unpinned `latest` URL with no integrity check — and passes the response body directly to `eval()`, then exposes the resulting `use()` as a global that dynamically installs and loads arbitrary npm packages at runtime. Because the fetch is unpinned and executed on every load of the module, whoever controls the `use-m` package on npm (or the unpkg cache) achieves code execution inside every process that imports or runs this package. This bypasses npm's dependency pinning, lockfile enforcement, and audit surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
